verdict.rationale: Fin's own documentation says teams can test the agent across thousands of scenarios before it goes live, without engineers. It also has a dedicated 'How to preview and test Fin' help article and describes testing performance before launch, which covers the simulated-conversation side of the story. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how simulations are built and scored, explicit replay against historical tickets, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support ops lead, I test the agent against historical tickets or simulated conversations before it faces real customers

citations.quote: you test it across thousands of scenarios before anything goes live
